title: infinity-1-topos
description: An (∞,1)-category satisfying descent (stable, effective colimits) — a context for homotopy-coherent logic and geometry, the ∞ analogue of a sheaf topos. An (∞,1)-category refined by the descent conditions.

descent.description: colimits are universal and effective (Giraud–Rezk–Lurie descent); local-to-global gluing holds coherently
